paper_title: Recent Progress in Flexible and Stretchable Organic Solar Cells

qa_pairs.question: What are the current state-of-the-art power conversion efficiencies (PCE) for single-junction and tandem flexible organic solar cells?
qa_pairs.answer: State-of-the-art single-junction flexible organic solar cells have achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 15.21%, while tandem flexible devices have reached a higher efficiency of 16.55%.
qa_pairs.source_title: Recent Progress in Flexible and Stretchable Organic Solar Cells

qa_pairs.question: What are the electrical and optical properties of Indium Tin Oxide (ITO) electrodes deposited on PET substrates via roll-to-roll sputtering?
qa_pairs.answer: Flexible ITO electrodes deposited on PET using roll-to-roll sputtering exhibit a sheet resistance of 47.4 Ω sq⁻¹ and an average optical transparency of 83.46% within the 500–550 nm wavelength range.
qa_pairs.source_title: Recent Progress in Flexible and Stretchable Organic Solar Cells

qa_pairs.question: How does the use of methanesulfonic acid (CH₃SO₃H) compare to concentrated sulfuric acid (H₂SO₄) in the post-treatment of PEDOT:PSS films for flexible electronics?
qa_pairs.answer: While concentrated H₂SO₄ can increase PEDOT:PSS conductivity to over 3000 S cm⁻¹, it is highly aggressive. Methanesulfonic acid (CH₃SO₃H) is a milder organic acid alternative that achieves a similarly high conductivity of 3300 S cm⁻¹ without damaging the flexible substrates.
qa_pairs.source_title: Recent Progress in Flexible and Stretchable Organic Solar Cells

qa_pairs.question: Why is the conventional high-temperature growth of ZnO buffer layers problematic for flexible organic solar cells, and what methods are used to overcome this?
qa_pairs.answer: The application of ZnO is limited by the low glass transition temperature (Tg) of flexible plastic substrates, which cannot withstand high-temperature processing. To address this, low-temperature growth methods such as atomic layer deposition (conducted at 80 °C) or mist pyrolysis (conducted at 180 °C) are employed.
qa_pairs.source_title: Recent Progress in Flexible and Stretchable Organic Solar Cells

qa_pairs.question: Compare the performance and mechanical stability of flexible organic solar cells using PI@graphene electrodes versus those using amorphous ZITO electrodes.
qa_pairs.answer: Devices using PI@graphene electrodes with a PM6:Y6 active layer achieve a PCE of 15.2% and retain 90% efficiency after 1000 bending cycles at a 2 mm radius. In comparison, devices using amorphous ZITO (Zn₀.₃In₀.₃Sn₀.₃O₃) electrodes maintain 85% of their initial PCE after only 10 flexing cycles at a larger radius of 5 mm.
qa_pairs.source_title: Recent Progress in Flexible and Stretchable Organic Solar Cells

qa_pairs.question: What physical characteristics make CVD-grown graphene an ideal candidate for flexible transparent electrodes?
qa_pairs.answer: Graphene produced via Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) is ideal due to its high electron mobility (2 × 10⁵ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹), high electrical conductivity (10⁴ S cm⁻¹), and excellent optical transparency of 97.7%.
qa_pairs.source_title: Recent Progress in Flexible and Stretchable Organic Solar Cells

qa_pairs.question: What are the two primary inherent material properties of PEDOT:PSS that lead to the degradation of flexible organic solar cells?
qa_pairs.answer: The degradation of flexible devices using PEDOT:PSS electrodes is primarily caused by the material's inherent hygroscopicity (tendency to absorb moisture) and its acidity.
qa_pairs.source_title: Recent Progress in Flexible and Stretchable Organic Solar Cells

qa_pairs.question: Describe the performance and scale of flexible organic solar cell modules fabricated using slot-die coating.
qa_pairs.answer: Slot-die coating has been used to fabricate large-area SMD2-based flexible modules with an active area of 80 cm², achieving a maximum power conversion efficiency of 5.25%. This technique is considered suitable for industrial-scale manufacturing.
qa_pairs.source_title: Recent Progress in Flexible and Stretchable Organic Solar Cells
